draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 66th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 3rd of 18 at TE. He lasted until pick 101, well after his grade rank (66th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Dalton Schultz. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 309 receiving yards in 2021, 12th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 58 career games and 30 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (2 AV) was his best yet. Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 179 receiving yards against a median of 179 (level with).
